narrative: On XX/XX/2026, I paid {$750.00} through PayPal Debit XXXX to XXXX for a prepaid hotel reservation at XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX for XXXX XXXX XXXX. To avoid being turned away, I paid the hotel directly. The hotel later charged my credit card {$620.00} for the stay.
